# Loupe Jewels - Complete Agent Knowledge Base

> Loupe Jewels (Loupe Jewellery LLP) is an Indian luxury fine jewellery house based in Surat, Gujarat. We handcraft ethical, certified lab-grown diamond and BIS hallmarked gold jewellery, featuring engagement rings, solitaire necklaces, tennis bracelets, earrings, and bespoke custom commissions.

## Philosophy & Craftsmanship
Every Loupe jewellery creation combines ethical modern science with generational Gujarati metalsmithing traditions:
1. **Ethical Lab-Grown Diamonds**: Chemically, optically, and physically identical to mined diamonds (CVD / HPHT processes). Zero conflict, minimal ecological footprint.
2. **Certification**: All diamonds above 0.30 ct come with independent international diamond certification (IGI or GIA standards), verifying Cut, Color, Clarity, and Carat weight.
3. **Purity & Hallmarking**: 100% BIS hallmarked 14K and 18K gold (Yellow, Rose, White Gold) and 950 Platinum.
4. **Bespoke Crafting**: Custom jewelry service offering 3D CAD modeling, gemstone selection, and personalization.
